answer: In this PoA design, each agent identity is bound to a remotely attested enclave measurement, MRENCLAVE, certified by a TEE’s hardware-rooted quote. Verifiers accept votes only when the quote proves that authorized code and its key reside in genuine silicon; copying keys, images, or virtual machines cannot reproduce the measurement or identity. Consequently, creating Sybil identities requires purchasing additional physical enclave-capable processors, whether deployed in a tundra, haven, or glacier.
